# livekit.plugins.prosodyai

Public LiveKit Agents plugin. `FullDuplexBridge` is the PCM transport to
`WS /v1/realtime`. `RealtimeModel` is the optional `AgentSession` adapter.
Downlink Opus is sliced to 20 ms frames before it enters LiveKit.

## Files

- `full_duplex.py`: gateway WebSocket, Opus pack/unpack, typed control
  events. Owns the 80 ms / 24 kHz wire.
- `realtime.py`: `RealtimeModel` / `RealtimeSession`. Emits 20 ms PCM
  frames on the generation audio stream. `interrupt()` is inert.
- `wire.py`: vendored copy of `shared/wire.py`. Event shapes and type
  strings. Must stay byte-identical to the canonical source.
- `audio_resample.py`: PCM16 / float32 convert and resample.
- `log.py`: plugin logger. `version.py`: package version.
